# Scenario: after a full cycle, every agent-managed host path has the expected
# mode — private where secrets live, traversable for nginx/ACME bind mounts.
# Legacy loose modes heal on the next cycle. Modes only (no second-user probes).

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: host layout perms fixture'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'
exec chmod 0755 check-perms.sh check-heal.sh

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2ecycle-web
exists $HOME/infra/apps/e2ecycle/docker-compose.yml
exists $HOME/infra/apps/e2ecycle/.env
exists $HOME/infra/docker-compose.yml
exists $HOME/infra/nginx/nginx.conf
exists $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2ecycle.conf
exists $HOME/infra/nginx/leconf/options-ssl-nginx.conf
exists $HOME/apinfra.lock
grep 'review-secret-sentinel' $HOME/infra/apps/e2ecycle/docker-compose.yml

exec ./check-perms.sh
stdout 'layout_perms_ok'

# Legacy permissive modes heal on the next unchanged cycle.
exec chmod 755 $HOME/infra/apps $HOME/infra/apps/e2ecycle
exec chmod 644 $HOME/infra/apps/e2ecycle/docker-compose.yml $HOME/infra/apps/e2ecycle/.env
exec chmod 644 $HOME/.apinfra $HOME/.env

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='

exec ./check-heal.sh
stdout 'layout_heal_ok'
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2ecycle-web
grep 'review-secret-sentinel' $HOME/infra/apps/e2ecycle/docker-compose.yml

-- check-perms.sh --
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

mode_of() {
	if stat -c %a "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
		stat -c %a "$1"
	else
		stat -f %Lp "$1"
	fi
}

check() {
	path=$1
	want=$2
	got=$(mode_of "$path")
	# BSD stat may omit a leading zero (e.g. 644 vs 0644); normalize.
	got=$(printf '%03d' "$got")
	want=$(printf '%03d' "$want")
	if [ "$got" != "$want" ]; then
		echo "FAIL $path got=$got want=$want" >&2
		exit 1
	fi
}

check "$HOME" 755
check "$HOME/infra" 755
check "$HOME/infra/nginx" 755
check "$HOME/infra/nginx/conf" 755
check "$HOME/infra/nginx/leconf" 755
check "$HOME/infra/certbot" 755
check "$HOME/infra/certbot/conf" 755
check "$HOME/infra/certbot/www" 755
check "$HOME/infra/mockcerts" 755
check "$HOME/infra/apps" 700
check "$HOME/infra/apps/e2ecycle" 700
check "$HOME/infra/apps/e2ecycle/docker-compose.yml" 400
check "$HOME/infra/apps/e2ecycle/.env" 400
check "$HOME/infra/docker-compose.yml" 644
check "$HOME/infra/nginx/nginx.conf" 644
check "$HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2ecycle.conf" 644
check "$HOME/infra/nginx/leconf/options-ssl-nginx.conf" 644
check "$HOME/.apinfra" 600
check "$HOME/.env" 600
check "$HOME/apinfra.lock" 600
if [ -f "$HOME/.installedCert" ]; then
	check "$HOME/.installedCert" 644
fi
if [ -f "$HOME/.events" ]; then
	check "$HOME/.events" 600
fi
echo layout_perms_ok

-- check-heal.sh --
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

mode_of() {
	if stat -c %a "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
		stat -c %a "$1"
	else
		stat -f %Lp "$1"
	fi
}

check() {
	path=$1
	want=$2
	got=$(mode_of "$path")
	got=$(printf '%03d' "$got")
	want=$(printf '%03d' "$want")
	if [ "$got" != "$want" ]; then
		echo "FAIL heal $path got=$got want=$want" >&2
		exit 1
	fi
}

check "$HOME/infra/apps" 700
check "$HOME/infra/apps/e2ecycle" 700
check "$HOME/infra/apps/e2ecycle/docker-compose.yml" 400
check "$HOME/infra/apps/e2ecycle/.env" 400
check "$HOME/.apinfra" 600
check "$HOME/.env" 600
check "$HOME/infra/certbot/www" 755
check "$HOME/infra/nginx/conf" 755
echo layout_heal_ok

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2ecycle
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9975
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2ecycle/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    environment:
      APP_PASSWORD: ${APP_PASSWORD}
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- .env --
E2ECYCLE_APP_PASSWORD=review-secret-sentinel
